# node_modules/mochiws

node:ws / WebSocket shim + httpGet/httpRequest over mochiws.dll (WinHTTP): GET verified; httpRequest(method,url,body,ct) enables POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE + payload

- **Orientation**: JS-first (Node.js NPM style)
- **Status**: verified — exercised against mbjs.exe

## Exports

```js
- `WebSocket`
- `connect`
- `send`
- `poll`
- `close`
- `httpGet`
- `httpRequest`
```

Maintained by the SEVM project. Regenerated by `script/gen_manifests.py`.
